posts.text:
We used to structure relief based on the notion that all victims are the same; that their religious or political identity, or their state’s leadership, didn’t matter. That is no longer true.

My latest Early Warning on the politics on disaster relief. Subscribe: 

substack.com/inbox/post/2...
